say:2:1360235001:1.text: Phew, that was a real scare... So, as you mentioned earlier, the Hypogean might still be around, right?
say:2:1360235001:1.source_cn: 呼，真是让人震惊……不过，按照你们刚刚说的，恶魔仍然有...

say:3:1360235002:1.text: Yeah, thanks to Temesia's hymn, we managed to flush him out.
say:3:1360235002:1.source_cn: 是的，之前如果不是主人让特弥希娅小姐唱圣歌，可能还没法...

say:4:1360235003:1.text: Hmm, how about you play your flute here, Merlin?
say:4:1360235003:1.source_cn: 唔，这样的话，梅林，你要不要在这里演奏一下？
say:4:1360235003:1.male: Hmm, how about you play your flute here, Merlin?
say:4:1360235003:1.female: Hmm, how about you play your flute here, Merlin?

say:5:1360235004:1.text: We can check if this place is under corrupted magic, as the first thing that goes wrong is usually the instrument.
say:5:1360235004:1.source_cn: 你看，如果声音发生了扭曲，那么最先出问题的通常是乐器。
say:5:1360235004:1.male: We can check if this place is under corrupted magic, as the first thing that goes wrong is usually the instrument.
say:5:1360235004:1.female: We can check if this place is under corrupted magic, as the first thing that goes wrong is usually the instrument.

say:6:1360235005:1.text: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!
say:6:1360235005:1.source_cn: 而你的演奏，如果注入了魔力，说不定也有圣歌的力量——这...
say:6:1360235005:1.male: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!
say:6:1360235005:1.female: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!

choice_prompt:7:1360235005.text: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!
choice_prompt:7:1360235005.source_cn: 而你的演奏，如果注入了魔力，说不定也有圣歌的力量——这样就一举两得了！
choice_prompt:7:1360235005.male: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!
choice_prompt:7:1360235005.female: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!

say:9:1360235006:1.text: You take out the flute you always carry with you and play a simple song.
say:9:1360235006:1.source_cn: 你取出随身携带的笛子，简单地演奏了一曲。
say:9:1360235006:1.male: You take out the flute you always carry with you and play a simple song.
say:9:1360235006:1.female: You take out the flute you always carry with you and play a simple song.

say:10:1360235007:1.text: The flute weaves a mesmerizing and enchanting melody, its delicate notes lingering in the air...
say:10:1360235007:1.source_cn: 清澈动听的笛音如此悠扬，即使已然结束，仿佛也依旧有袅袅...

say:11:1360235008:1.text: Phew... That melody took away Chippy's breath.
say:11:1360235008:1.male: Phew... That melody took away Chippy's breath.
say:11:1360235008:1.female: Phew... That melody took away Chippy's breath.

say:12:1360235009:1.source_cn: 太好听了，主人！好美的笛声啊！

say:13:1360235010:0.text: Nothing happened. Looks like this place's alright!
say:13:1360235010:0.source_cn: 周围也没有什么变化，看起来是已经净化干净了！
say:13:1360235010:0.male: Nothing happened. Looks like this place's alright!
say:13:1360235010:0.female: Nothing happened. Looks like this place's alright!

say:14:1360235011:0.text: It was truly wonderful to be an audience of Magister's performance...
say:14:1360235011:0.source_cn: 嗯，不过能听到主人的美妙演奏，也很幸福啊……
say:14:1360235011:0.male: It was truly wonderful to be an audience of Magister's performance...
say:14:1360235011:0.female: It was truly wonderful to be an audience of Magister's performance...

say:15:1360235012:1.text: Speaking of music, didn't Berial say he wanted to perform for his sealed Hypogean friends?
say:15:1360235012:1.source_cn: 说起来，那个贝利尔不是说他要给每个被封印的恶魔带去音乐吗。

say:16:1360235013:1.text: Aren't Hypogeans emotionless creatures that follow only their instincts? They must despise each other too!
say:16:1360235013:1.source_cn: 但恶魔不是连彼此之间都憎恶的，完全混乱，只有欲望没有情...

say:17:1360235014:1.text: You make a good point, Hammie. Most Hypogeans don't even have dreams.
say:17:1360235014:1.source_cn: 确实如你所说，大部分恶魔甚至连梦境都没有。

say:18:1360235015:1.text: Even if they do, their dreams are often evil, corrupted, and chaotic—a twisted maze far worse than any of our nightmares.
say:18:1360235015:1.source_cn: 如果有，也是邪恶而又腐败，甚至混乱到让无法涉足的，超越...

say:19:1360235016:1.text: Though... they do occasionally dream of nice things too.
say:19:1360235016:1.source_cn: 不过呢，就算是那种东西，偶尔也会有美梦哦？

say:20:1360235017:1.source_cn: 就像是毒药外面也会裹上一层糖衣那样。

say:21:1360235018:0.text: It's corrupted inside, but the sweetness outside is sometimes worth savoring.
say:21:1360235018:0.source_cn: 你不能否认里面有着致命的丑恶，但你同样也不能否认，在它...

say:22:1360235019:0.text: Hmm, Chippy can't make heads or tails of this, but Chippy's sure Berial has no conscience!
say:22:1360235019:0.source_cn: 唔，有点难懂。但满满觉得，贝利尔绝对没有任何好心肠可言！

say:23:1360235020:0.text: Either he wants to flaunt his freedom in front of his sealed peers, or he wants to get under their skin with his awful songs!
say:23:1360235020:0.source_cn: 没错，他要不然是想跟那些被封印的家伙炫耀，要不然就是想...

say:24:1360235021:1.text: Although Berial's true motive remains a mystery, the matter here has been resolved. It's time to say goodbye to Tasi.
say:24:1360235021:1.source_cn: 无论贝利尔的目的究竟为何，这里的问题既然已经告一段落，...

say:25:1360235022:0.text: I'll keep an eye on Harak's seal here.
say:25:1360235022:0.source_cn: 我会留在这里再次确认哈拉克的封印是否完整，交给我吧。

say:26:1360235023:1.text: We have faith in you, Tasi! See you next time!
say:26:1360235023:1.source_cn: 那么，拜托了，塔西！我们走啦！

say:28:1360235024:0.text: You stroll toward the cave entrance. As soon as you're out of Tasi's sight, you signal to your familiars and hide in a corner.
say:28:1360235024:0.source_cn: 你们朝洞窟外走去，然而，刚刚离开塔西的视线，你就示意了...

say:29:1360235025:0.text: Meanwhile, a sly smirk creeps across Tasi's face.
say:29:1360235025:0.source_cn: 紧接着，留在原地的塔西，露出了奇异的微笑！

say:30:1360235026:2.text: What a terrific flutist! It takes years of practice to master that kind of technique.
say:30:1360235026:2.source_cn: 真是不错的笛声呀，这可不是初学者能有的技术。

say:31:1360235027:0.text: Hasn't he lost his memory? How is he still able to play the instruments as well as he did before?
say:31:1360235027:0.source_cn: 明明都失忆了，但无论笛子、鲁特琴还是别的乐器都像以前一...
say:31:1360235027:0.male: Hasn't he lost his memory? How is he still able to play the instruments as well as he did before?
say:31:1360235027:0.female: Hasn't she lost her memory? How is she still able to play the instruments as well as she did before?

say:32:1360235028:0.text: It can't possibly be muscle memory, can it? Hahahaha!
say:32:1360235028:0.source_cn: 总不会是因为演奏属于身体的记忆吧——哈哈哈哈哈哈！

say:33:1360235029:0.text: I wish someone were here to listen to my jokes, but the audience has to have a sense of humor too!
say:33:1360235029:0.source_cn: 真是的，所有的笑话没有听众就失去了一半色彩，而如果听众...

say:34:1360235030:0.text: Music is such a powerful tool. After all, even creatures as brainless as fish respond to it.
say:34:1360235030:0.source_cn: 音乐这东西倒是很方便，就算是没脑子的蠢鱼听到了估计也会...

say:35:1360235031:0.text: Wait, can fish actually hear anything? I guess they use their senses only to hunt food.
say:35:1360235031:0.source_cn: ……啧，不过那家伙真的有所谓的听力吗。五感全都聚集到食...

say:36:1360235032:0.text: Never mind. Anyway, this mission is a success...
say:36:1360235032:0.source_cn: 算了，不管怎么说，本次行动，成功成功——

say:38:1360235033:0.text: It's you, Berial! You fooled us!
say:38:1360235033:0.source_cn: 居然是你！贝利尔！你骗我们！

say:39:1360235034:1.text: In response to Chippy's sudden appearance, Berial breaks into a wry smile, as if he's been expecting this showdown.
say:39:1360235034:1.source_cn: 面对着跳出来的满满，眼前贝利尔所化成的塔西却再次露出了...

say:41:1360235035:0.text: Once again, Berial's figure leaps out from the twisted shadow.
say:41:1360235035:0.source_cn: 暗影扭曲着，贝利尔的身形再次从空气中一跃而出！

say:42:1360235036:0.text: I was about to celebrate my success just now.
say:42:1360235036:0.source_cn: 刚刚我还在想，要不要说“耍了一次梅林，开心！”之类的。
say:42:1360235036:0.male: I was about to celebrate my success just now.
say:42:1360235036:0.female: I was about to celebrate my success just now.

say:43:1360235037:0.text: You knew it was me all along, didn't you?
say:43:1360235037:0.source_cn: 不过，其实你早就发现是我了对吧？
say:43:1360235037:0.male: You knew it was me all along, didn't you?
say:43:1360235037:0.female: You knew it was me all along, didn't you?

say:44:1360235038:0.text: When you took my suggestion and played the flute.
say:44:1360235038:0.source_cn: 就在你顺着我的意思吹笛子的时候。
say:44:1360235038:0.male: When you took my suggestion and played the flute.
say:44:1360235038:0.female: When you took my suggestion and played the flute.

say:46:1360235039:1.text: B-but, why didn't the flute purify you?
say:46:1360235039:1.source_cn: 那、那为什么，为什么主人的笛音没有净化你！

say:47:1360235040:0.text: Tsk! Can't you pretend to be tricked for once so I can have some fun?
say:47:1360235040:0.source_cn: 啊——真是的，每次都这么敏锐，就不能让我畅快地玩一下吗？
say:47:1360235040:0.male: Tsk! Can't you pretend to be tricked for once so I can have some fun?
say:47:1360235040:0.female: Tsk! Can't you pretend to be tricked for once so I can have some fun?

say:48:1360235041:1.text: Or you just don't feel like playing along with my shadow?
say:48:1360235041:1.source_cn: 还是说，不是本体来陪你，你就像我一样提不起兴致？
say:48:1360235041:1.male: Or you just don't feel like playing along with my shadow?
say:48:1360235041:1.female: Or you just don't feel like playing along with my shadow?

say:49:1360235042:1.text: I assure you—my shadow is nothing like the illusion that Phraesto conjures up.
say:49:1360235042:1.source_cn: 不要看不起影子啊，我和普鲁斯托那个大块头不一样，对幻术...

say:50:1360235043:1.text: You know how I feel every time I possess or transform into someone? I have to fight the urge to tear them apart and devour them!
say:50:1360235043:1.source_cn: 每次附体也好变形也罢，可是要拼命压抑着把对方从内到外一...

say:51:1360235044:1.text: Compared to Harak, I'm almost as restrained as Dura's acolytes!
say:51:1360235044:1.source_cn: 真是的，和哈拉克比，我简直像是艾雅的部下们一样禁欲啊。
